entries: The standard Pistol is an early Story Mode handgun sold by Ammu-Nation after early story progress. It supports common upgrades such as an extended magazine, flashlight, and suppressor.
Combat Pistol is a more accurate service-style handgun than the basic Pistol and becomes available as the story progresses. It supports an extended magazine, flashlight, and suppressor.
AP Pistol is a fully automatic handgun and one of the strongest Story Mode drive-by weapons because it combines automatic fire with one-handed vehicle use.
Heavy Pistol is a higher-damage handgun added through a title update. It offers more per-shot power than the standard Pistol while remaining a conventional sidearm.
SNS Pistol is a compact handgun with a small magazine. It is useful mainly as a lightweight sidearm rather than a high-capacity combat weapon.
Pistol .50 is a high-caliber semi-automatic handgun with strong per-shot damage and a smaller magazine than automatic sidearms. Availability can depend on edition or bonus content.
Vintage Pistol is a classic-styled semi-automatic handgun added through a title update. It trades modern capacity for distinctive styling and moderate performance.

Marksman Pistol is an extremely high-damage single-shot handgun. It punishes missed shots because it must be reloaded after each shot, making it more of a precision novelty than an all-purpose sidearm.
Stun Gun incapacitates human targets with an electrical shot and then needs time to recharge. It appears in Story Mode and behaves differently from some later GTA Online implementations.
Pump Shotgun is a reliable early Story Mode shotgun with strong close-range damage. It can take a flashlight and suppressor in Story Mode.
Sawed-Off Shotgun has very high close-range damage but limited range and capacity. It is best used at very short distances.
Assault Shotgun is one of Story Mode's strongest close-range firearms because it combines shotgun damage with rapid semi-automatic fire and a large optional magazine.
Bullpup Shotgun is a compact shotgun available in supported editions or bonus configurations. Its exact availability depends on the game version.
Heavy Shotgun is a powerful magazine-fed shotgun added by title update. It is one of the strongest balanced shotguns due to high damage, useful fire rate, and optional large magazines.
Musket is a slow-loading historical firearm with very high per-shot damage and long effective range for its class. Its slow fire rate makes it situational.
Micro SMG is an early compact automatic weapon and a useful drive-by option before stronger vehicle-capable firearms become available.
SMG offers better sustained automatic fire and range than the Micro SMG and supports common attachments in Story Mode.
Assault SMG is a compact automatic weapon tied to Rockstar account or edition-related unlock conditions in Story Mode rather than normal story progression alone.
Combat PDW is a title-update personal-defense weapon with good control and attachment support. Availability depends on an edition that includes the relevant update content.
MG is a sustained-fire machine gun with a larger magazine and more range than most SMGs, suited to longer firefights.
Combat MG is one of Story Mode's strongest sustained-fire weapons, combining high damage, good range, and a very large extended magazine.
Gusenberg Sweeper is a Tommy-gun-style weapon added through title update content. In Story Mode it becomes available after completing an ending in supported versions.
Assault Rifle is a common automatic rifle found on many enemies and sold early in Story Mode. It is easy to obtain but generally less refined than the Carbine Rifle.

Special Carbine is a title-update assault rifle with strong all-round stats and broad attachment support. It is an excellent alternative to the standard Carbine Rifle in supported Story Mode versions.
Advanced Rifle is a fast-firing assault rifle that becomes available late in Story Mode, around completion of The Big Score in supported versions.
Bullpup Rifle is a compact automatic rifle added through title-update content and becomes available late in the Story Mode progression in supported editions.
Sniper Rifle is the standard long-range precision rifle. It unlocks earlier than the Heavy Sniper and supports useful scope and suppressor options.
Heavy Sniper is Story Mode's hardest-hitting conventional sniper rifle, with excellent range and accuracy. It is the preferred choice for raw long-range damage once unlocked.
Marksman Rifle is a faster-firing semi-automatic precision rifle added through title-update content. It trades some single-shot power for quicker follow-up shots.
Grenade Launcher fires explosive rounds on an arc and is useful against clustered enemies and vehicles when an RPG would be too direct.
Homing Launcher is a title-update anti-vehicle weapon that can lock onto suitable targets, especially aircraft. It is expensive and edition/update dependent.

Minigun provides extremely high sustained fire and is devastating against groups and vehicles, but its spin-up, movement limitations, and ammunition consumption make it less convenient for ordinary fights.
Railgun is an Enhanced-era Story Mode heavy weapon that fires extremely powerful electromagnetic projectiles. It is not available in every legacy console edition.
RPG is a direct-fire rocket launcher and one of Story Mode's most destructive anti-vehicle weapons. It excels against armored vehicles and clustered targets but requires care at close range.
Firework Launcher is a novelty explosive weapon added through title-update content. Availability in Story Mode depends on version and installed update content.
Grenade is a timed throwable explosive. Use cover and throw distance carefully because the fuse continues after the grenade leaves the character's hand.
Sticky Bomb attaches to surfaces and vehicles and is detonated remotely. It is one of the most useful Story Mode explosives for traps, vehicles, and scripted objectives.
Tear Gas creates a lingering harmful cloud and is better for controlling an area than for immediate explosive damage.
Molotov Cocktail creates burning ground and can ignite people and flammable objects. In Story Mode it is primarily found as a world pickup rather than purchased normally from Ammu-Nation.
Proximity Mine is a title-update explosive that detonates when a target enters its trigger area. Availability depends on the Story Mode version and installed updates.
Jerry Can pours a trail of fuel that can be ignited, allowing controlled fire traps and environmental burning.
Knife is a basic melee weapon useful for close combat and stealth takedowns when firearms would attract more attention.
Nightstick is a police-style melee weapon that can be obtained and carried for close-range combat.
Hammer is a melee weapon associated with some edition bonus content. Availability can differ by platform and edition.
Baseball Bat is a blunt melee weapon found at fixed world locations rather than normally bought from Ammu-Nation.
Crowbar is a melee weapon found at several fixed world locations and industrial sites.
Golf Club can be used as a melee weapon and is naturally associated with the Los Santos Golf Club and golf activity.
Hatchet is a melee weapon available in supported Enhanced-era Story Mode versions and is not universal to the original PS3/Xbox 360 release.
Machete is a large bladed melee weapon added through later content and is edition-dependent in Story Mode.
Knuckledusters are fist-mounted melee weapons added through title-update content. They increase close-range melee damage and have cosmetic variants in supported versions.
